//: Hand-maintained entries of the epsil.dev symbol search, for what the library data does not name: operators, keywords and language forms. `scripts/build-search.mjs` merges them with config/epsil-search-symbols.json and fails on a URL whose page or anchor does not exist. `terms` are matched whole and case-insensitively, before any library name.

aliases.title: |> pipe
aliases.summary: Pass a value to a function: x |> f is f(x).

aliases.title: => anonymous function
aliases.summary: A function literal: x => x^2. |-> is the former spelling.

aliases.title: .. range
aliases.summary: A range of numbers: 1..10.

aliases.title: ... spread
aliases.summary: Spread a collection into a call or a literal, or bind the rest of a pattern.

aliases.title: ?? absence coalescing
aliases.summary: a ?? b is a unless a is missing or NaN, then b.

aliases.title: ?! presence assertion
aliases.summary: x?! is x, or an error when x is missing or NaN.

aliases.title: is type test
aliases.summary: x is T tests whether a value has a type.

aliases.title: Assignment and equality
aliases.summary: = declares or assigns, == compares values, === compares structure.

aliases.title: && || ! logic operators
aliases.summary: And, or and not.

aliases.title: % modulo
aliases.summary: The remainder of a division.

aliases.title: :: qualified name
aliases.summary: std::name names a library definition even when a local binding shadows it.

aliases.title: Operator precedence
aliases.summary: Every operator with its spelling, precedence and associativity.

aliases.title: if / else
aliases.summary: A conditional; it is an expression and produces a value.

aliases.title: if let
aliases.summary: Run a branch when a value matches a pattern, binding its parts.

aliases.title: match
aliases.summary: Choose a branch by the shape of a value.

aliases.title: for and while loops
aliases.summary: Repeat a block for each element, or while a condition holds.

aliases.title: Parallel loops
aliases.summary: Loops and comprehensions whose iterations are independent.

aliases.title: break and continue
aliases.summary: Leave a loop, or go on to its next iteration.

aliases.title: return
aliases.summary: Leave a function with a value.

aliases.title: Functions
aliases.summary: Declaring functions: one-line, block and multi-clause forms.

aliases.title: do { … } block
aliases.summary: A block that is an expression.

aliases.title: let and var
aliases.summary: Declaring a binding.

aliases.title: type alias
aliases.summary: A new name for an existing type.

aliases.title: Nominal types
aliases.summary: A type distinct from its representation.

aliases.title: Generic functions
aliases.summary: Functions with type parameters.

aliases.title: $…$ LaTeX islands
aliases.summary: LaTeX inside Epsil source: $\frac{1}{n}$.

aliases.title: Interpolated strings
aliases.summary: Strings with embedded expressions.

aliases.title: Comments
aliases.summary: Line, block and documentation comments.

aliases.title: Values and bindings
aliases.summary: Values never change; a binding can.

aliases.title: Errors are values
aliases.summary: A failed computation produces a value, not an exception.
